label: Used textiles generated

source_record: Approx. 1.45 million tonnes of used textiles generated in UK in 2022
methodology_note: Product-specific generation estimate; not a total waste balance.

source_detail: Furniture/furnishings disposed in municipal residual waste
label: Furniture & furnishings disposed
source_name: Defra Waste Prevention Programme for England (citing WRAP)
source_record: Over 861,000 tonnes furniture incl. mattresses, carpets and underlay disposed in residual waste, England 2017
methodology_note: Historical England-only estimate; do not aggregate into a current UK total.
scope_note: Strong object/structure relevance.

label: WEEE & other scrap metals
source_name: Defra Local authority collected waste management 2024/25
source_record: Table 2, 2024: WEEE & other scrap metals = 522 thousand tonnes
methodology_note: Separately collected/recycled household stream, not total WEEE discarded; combined category.
scope_note: Current proxy proving a final-product Use→End relationship.
notes: Replace with dedicated Environment Agency UK WEEE series when ingested.

label: Textiles separately collected
source_name: Defra Local authority collected waste management 2024/25
source_record: Table 2, 2024: Textiles = 99 thousand tonnes
methodology_note: Separately collected/recycled household textiles only.
scope_note: Do not substitute for the broader UK used-textiles generation estimate.

label: Other manufactured-product dry recycling
source_name: Defra Local authority collected waste management 2024/25
source_record: Table 2, 2024: Other materials = 832 thousand tonnes
methodology_note: Heterogeneous category including batteries, bric-a-brac, chipboard/MDF, furniture, mattresses, tyres, paint, wood, media and other items.
scope_note: Useful bundled Other product stream; not a pure object-only category.

label: Packaging recycled
source_name: Defra UK statistics on waste
source_record: Table 4 Methodology 1, UK 2024: packaging recycled = 8,154 thousand tonnes
methodology_note: Packaging-specific weak loop using NPWD recycling tonnage / PackFlow methodology 1.
scope_note: Keep secondary because packaging can dominate and is not the core research focus.

label: Non-hazardous C&D waste generation proxy
source_name: Defra UK statistics on waste
source_record: UK non-hazardous construction and demolition waste generated, 2020
methodology_note: Combines construction-stage and demolition/end-of-life waste; do not map all of it to Use→End.
scope_note: Relevant to structures; demolition-only separation required.

scope_note: Do not assign the whole total to Fabrication or any single stage.
